basis: Protocol requires independent review, relevance judgments and a workload pilot.

criteria.automated: Zero untriaged cross-work identity or identifier conflicts.
criteria.human: Verify exact title, authorship and work identity for 100% of publishable works.

criteria.automated: Validate checksums and report all competing edition IDs.
criteria.human: Verify at least one edition for 90% of works; independently document editions without an ISBN.

criteria.automated: Count missing required fields and hold conflicting values.
criteria.human: At least 90% have approved genre, form, themes, subjects, language and a spoiler-safe synopsis.

criteria.automated: 100% of populated assertions carry public evidence references.
criteria.human: Check evidence supports each approved field and document reuse basis.

criteria.automated: Report conflicting work keys, ISBNs and all legacy UUID candidates.
criteria.human: Zero unresolved identity conflicts in the proposed release subset; review any legacy map separately.

criteria.automated: Known-title top-five at least 95%; report weak and empty result sets.
criteria.human: At least two raters on 20 discovery queries; 80% have a relevant top-three result, 90% of explanations are supported, and zero severe spoilers.

criteria.automated: Slice coverage and empty results by query and edition language.
criteria.human: Verify at least five Kiswahili works and use at least six Kiswahili discovery queries; target 70% relevant top-three within that slice.

criteria.automated: Count queue items and record elapsed review minutes per work.
criteria.human: Time a ten-work review pilot; target a median of 20 minutes or less and document escalations.
